era: 1863 年 7 月 30 日生于密歇根州迪尔伯恩（Springwells）农场，父亲是爱尔兰移民农场主——少年拆装家里的钟表与农具，12 岁第一次见到路上行驶的蒸汽拖拉机，立志造'不需要马的车'——1879 年赴底特律当机械学徒，1891 年入职爱迪生照明公司，两年内升总工程师——1896 年在自家棚屋里造出第一辆四轮汽车（Quadricycle），当晚因门太窄抡斧破墙而出——1899 年创办底特律汽车公司失败，1901 年亨利·福特公司再被股东逐出（后改组为凯迪拉克）——1903 年第三次创业成立福特汽车公司，靠赛车'箭号'的胜利打开名声——1908 年推出 T 型车：钒钢车架、轻且耐烂路，定价 850 美元，'为大众造车'——1913 年在 海兰帕克工厂把装配时间从 12.5 小时压到 93 分钟：让工件移动、工人固定，流水线由此诞生——1914 年 1 月宣布日薪 5 美元（约为当时行情两倍）并把工时降到 8 小时，《华尔街日报》骂作'经济犯罪'，而次年离职率从 370% 骤降、申请者排队上万——价格随规模一路下降：T 型车从 850 美元降到 1925 年的 260 美元，美国道路上过半的汽车是 T 型——1917 年起建迪尔伯恩的胭脂河工厂：从矿石、橡胶林（福特兰迪亚）、船队到整车，纵向一体化走到极致——1919 年买断全部股东自立，'我的顾客可以要任何颜色，只要它是黑色'——1911 年起与塞尔登专利联盟缠斗八年胜诉，专利体系形同虚设，全行业开放竞争——1927 年 T 型停产，共售 1500 余万辆；同年压上全部身家赌 A 型车换型，险些翻船——1930 年代福特兰迪亚橡胶殖民实验惨败；对工会与哈里·贝内特的暴力路线重创声誉，1937 年'天桥之战'臭名昭著——1941 年在妻子克拉拉'若罢工你便卖厂'的最后通牒下签署首个全行业 UAW 合同——1947 年 4 月 7 日家中去世，停电的烛光下，报纸把'他让美国装上车轮'写成讣告的第一句。
era_en: Born 30 July 1863 on a Springwells Township, Michigan farm to an Irish-immigrant farmer — took apart the household clocks and farm machines as a boy, and at twelve, seeing a road locomotive, resolved to build 'a carriage without a horse' — apprenticed as a machinist in Detroit from 1879; joined Edison Illuminating in 1891, chief engineer within two years — built his first Quadricycle in a shed behind his house in 1896, axeing down the doorway to drive it out — the Detroit Automobile Company (1899) failed and he was pushed out of Henry Ford Company (1901, later Cadillac) — third venture, Ford Motor Company (1903), rode the racing car 'Arrow' to fame — the Model T of 1908: vanadium-steel frame, light and proof against rutted roads, priced at $850, 'a car for the great multitude' — in 1913 at Highland Park he cut assembly from 12.5 hours to 93 minutes by making the work move and the workers stand still: the moving assembly line — in January 1914 the five-dollar day, roughly twice the market wage with an eight-hour day; the Wall Street Journal called it economic crime, turnover collapsed from 370% and thousands queued for work — price fell with scale: $850 to $260 by 1925, over half the cars on American roads a Model T — from 1917 the River Rouge complex: ore, rubber plantations (Fordlandia), a shipping fleet, to finished cars in one chain — bought out all shareholders in 1919: 'any colour so long as it is black' — fought the Selden patent trust for eight years and won in 1911, leaving the patent effectively worthless and the industry open — the T laid down in 1927 after 15 million; the same year bet everything on the Model A and nearly capsized — Fordlandia's rubber colony a disaster in the 1930s; the Service Department and Harry Bennett, the Battle of the Overpass (1937), wrecked his name — in 1941, under Clara Ford's ultimatum ('if there is a strike, you sell the plant'), he signed the industry's first full UAW contract — died 7 April 1947 by candlelight during a local power cut; the obituaries led with 'he put America on wheels'.
school: 大规模生产工程 / 工业组织与流程设计 / 劳动经济学（工资与效率）/ 纵向一体化供应链 / 消费品定价与大众市场
historical_significance: 把汽车从富人的玩具变成大众的耐用消费品：流水线使装配时间从 12.5 小时降到 93 分钟，T 型车价格从 850 美元降到 260 美元，产量占全美一半以上；日薪 5 美元把'劳动力成本'重新定义为'顾客来源'，工人的工资第一次成为产品需求的一部分；他对抗塞尔登专利联盟并使其专利失效，与瓦特的专利收租形成方法论的正反面；胭脂河工厂把纵向一体化推到'矿石进、整车出'的极限；他晚年拒改 T 型车近二十年被通用反超，则是'成功公式神圣化'的最著名代价——大规模生产范式、8 小时工作制的普及、中产车主阶层的诞生，都以他的工厂为起点。
historical_significance_en: He turned the automobile from a rich man's toy into the people's durable good: the moving line cut assembly from 12.5 hours to 93 minutes, the Model T's price fell from $850 to $260, and at peak more than half the cars on American roads were Ts; the five-dollar day redefined 'labour cost' as 'customer source', making workers' wages part of product demand for the first time; he fought the Selden patent trust until the patent was worthless — the mirror image of Watt's patent rent; River Rouge pushed vertical integration to ore-in, car-out; and his two-decade refusal to change the Model T while General Motors ate the market is the most famous price of sacralising a successful formula — mass production, the spread of the eight-hour day and the birth of the middle-class car-owning mass all begin at his factories.
unique_thinking: 福特的思维内核是'把价格当成设计输入，把成本当成设计变量'：他先给 T 型车定一个能让大众掏钱的零售价，再让全厂去够这个价格——'价钱先于成本，成本是被造出来的'；第二个内核是'让工件移动、让人固定'：不是工人围着车走，而是车流过工人，把复杂装配拆成人人 90 秒可完成的动作序列——简单不是愚钝工人，是让系统对任何人友好；第三个内核是'工资是需求侧投资'：日薪 5 美元不是慈善，是让流水线造出的车有买主——高工资、低价格、大产量互为因果的循环；他对'减法'有近乎洁癖的信仰：能去掉的零件就去掉，能统一的规格就统一，'简化先于自动化'；他坚持在失败现场之外也要'利用失败'：福特兰迪亚的橡胶实验失败后，他把教训带回了种植与人事制度；而他最大的思维盲区也在自己身上——T 型车的成功让他把'减法'变成教条，当市场要颜色、要款式、要信贷时，他答'只要黑色'，用十九年教会全行业：公式会过期。
unique_thinking_en: Ford's cognitive core is 'price as design input, cost as a design variable': he set the Model T's retail price where the multitude could pay, then made the whole plant reach for it — price first, cost is manufactured; his second core is 'make the work move, keep the person still': not workers circling the car but the car flowing past workers, assembly decomposed into motions anyone can do in ninety seconds — simplification is not contempt for the worker, it is making the system hospitable to anyone; his third core is 'wages as demand-side investment': the five-dollar day was not charity but the act of giving the line's output a buyer — high wages, low prices and great volume as one causal loop; he held an almost ascetic faith in subtraction: remove the part, unify the spec — simplification precedes automation; he insisted on mining failure outside the failure site: Fordlandia's collapse fed lessons back into planting and personnel; and his greatest blind spot was his own success — the T's triumph hardened subtraction into dogma, and when the market asked for colour, style and credit he answered 'any colour so long as it is black', taking nineteen years to teach the whole industry that formulas expire.
civilization_zh: 美国镀金时代与进步时代：中西部农场的实用机械文化、底特律的作坊-工厂生态、爱迪生门洛帕克的发明共同体、大规模移民劳动力的到来、反垄断诉讼与谢尔曼法的产权政治、消费社会与分期付款文化的兴起
civilization_en: Gilded-Age and Progressive-Era America: the practical machine culture of midwestern farms, Detroit's shop-floor-to-factory ecosystem, Edison's Menlo Park circle, the arrival of mass immigrant labour, the property politics of antitrust and the Sherman Act, and the rise of the consumer society with its instalment credit
roles_zh: 发明家与赛车手；大规模生产体系的设计者；福特汽车公司创始人；劳动经济实验者（日薪 5 美元）；纵向一体化供应链先行者
roles_en: Inventor and racing driver; architect of mass production; founder of Ford Motor Company; labour-economics experimenter (the five-dollar day); pioneer of vertically integrated supply chains
key_works: 《我的人生与工作》(My Life and Work, 1922)——'价格先于成本'与大规模生产哲学的自述
海兰帕克流水线 (1913)——移动装配线：工件移动、工人固定
日薪 5 美元公告 (1914-01-05)——8 小时工作日与利润分享式工资的劳动经济实验
T 型车 (1908-1927)——1500 万辆：从 850 美元到 260 美元的价格曲线
塞尔登专利诉讼胜诉 (1911)——推翻行业专利联盟，开放式竞争格局
胭脂河工厂 (1917 起)——矿石到整车的纵向一体化极限工程
key_concepts: 移动装配线 the moving assembly line（工件移动、工人固定——让物料走过加工者）
先价后本 price before cost（零售价是设计输入，成本是被造出来的变量）
日薪 5 美元 the five-dollar day（高工资低价格大产量互为因果的循环）
极致削简 radical simplification（'任何颜色，只要黑色'——减法先于自动化）
纵向一体化 vertical integration（胭脂河：矿石进、整车出）
废料变现 waste monetisation（木箱变地板、锯末变炭——废料是放错位置的产品）
公式过期 formula expiry（T 型车的二十年僵化——成功公式的保质期）
cross_references: M-FOR-003（先价后本法——全部经营逻辑的起点：价格是设计输入而非结果）
M-FOR-001（动线革命法——工件移动、工人固定的流水线本体）
M-FOR-010（成功自误法——T 型车僵化二十年：公式过期的代价与自警）
M-WAT-008（瓦特·专利收租法——方法论正反面：瓦特以专利收租压制行业，福特以专利失效打开行业）
M-WAT-005（瓦特·标尺定价法——同以度量立价：瓦特造马力单位使效率可售，福特以先定价倒推成本使大众市场可造）
M-WAT-002（瓦特·冷热解耦法——同以分而治之立结构：瓦特分冷热，福特分工序）
M-NIG-006（南丁格尔·标准格式法——同以标准化立行业之规：一个统一统计格式，一个统一零件与工序）

modes.domain_zh: 方法论/让工件移动而人固定，以物料流重组整个生产过程
modes.domain_en: Methodology / making the work move and the person stand still, reorganising production as a flow of material
modes.definition_zh: 生产方法论/当'效率上不去'时，不问'人怎么更快'，先问'物料怎么走'：1913 年前汽车装配是'人围着车转'——技工带着工具在静止底盘间穿梭找料，时间大半花在走路与等待上；福特反其道：让底盘以固定速度沿轨道移动，每人守一个工位只做一组动作，料送到手边——装配从 12.5 小时压到 93 分钟；关键不是'传送带'这台设备，而是视角反转：把浪费的搜索路径（人找料）换成零浪费的直线（料找人）；流水线的灵感部分来自芝加哥屠宰场的'拆卸线'——牛挂在钩上流过刀手，他把它倒过来装：拆卸线拆整车，装配线装整车
modes.definition_en: Production methodology: when efficiency stalls, do not first ask 'how can people go faster' — ask 'how does the material travel': before 1913, assembly meant people orbiting a stationary car, mechanics hunting parts across the floor; Ford reversed it — the chassis moves at a fixed pace along a track, each worker holds one station doing one set of motions, parts arrive at the hand: 12.5 hours became 93 minutes; the essence is not the conveyor belt as hardware but the inversion of viewpoint: replace the wasteful search path (people finding parts) with a zero-waste line (parts finding people); part of the inspiration came from Chicago packinghouses' disassembly line — carcasses flowing past stationary cutters on hooks — which he turned around: they took a car apart, he put one together
modes.source_chapter: 《我的人生与工作》第 5-6 章流水线叙述；海兰帕克工厂 1913-14 装配时间记录
modes.key_quote_zh: 不是人围着车走，是车走过人——把人脚下浪费的路，换成车轮走过的路。
modes.key_quote_en: It is not the man who walks around the car — it is the car that walks past the man; turn the miles wasted underfoot into miles travelled by wheel.
key_concepts: 物料优先 material first（先优化物料的路径，再优化人的动作）
工位固定 the fixed station（一人一组动作，学习曲线压到最短）
节拍 takt the pace（线速即生产计划——用物理速度管理产量）
process_zh: 给浪费记账：记录装配一辆车的时间里，走动/找料/等待各占多少——浪费在'人与物的相对运动'里
反转视角：问'让谁移动最便宜'——移动工件比移动工人便宜得多（工件没有腿也没有意见）
把总任务拆成等时动作序列：每个工位一个动作组，动作时长对齐线速
让线速本身成为管理工具：产量由传送带速度决定，加产量=加节拍而非加督促
process_en: Audit the waste: record how much of a car's assembly time is walking, fetching, waiting — waste lives in the relative motion of people and things
Invert the viewpoint: ask 'what is cheapest to move' — moving the work is far cheaper than moving the workers (workpieces have neither legs nor opinions)
Decompose the total task into timed motions: one motion-set per station, each aligned to the line speed
Make the line speed itself the manager: output is set by belt speed — more volume means a faster takt, not more exhortation
representative_cases_zh: 海兰帕克磁电机装配 (1913-04)：先在磁电机线上试'件动人不动'，单件工时从 20 分钟降到 13 分钟——流水线先在小组件上证明自己
底盘装配线 (1913-1914)：91 个工位、装配 12.5 小时→1.5 小时；随后全厂改造，T 型车总装压到 93 分钟
倒置的屠宰场：芝加哥阿莫尔屠宰场的'拆卸线'（牛动刀不动）被他反转为'装配线'（车动人不动）——类比迁移
representative_cases_en: The magneto line (April 1913): 'work moves, man stands' trialled on magnetos first — unit time from 20 minutes to 13; the line proved itself on a small component
The chassis line (1913-14): 91 stations, assembly from 12.5 hours to 1.5; plant-wide conversion followed, final T assembly at 93 minutes
The inverted packinghouse: Armour's disassembly line (the carcass moves, the knife waits) reversed into an assembly line (the car moves, the fitter waits) — analogy carried across industries
modern_applications_zh: 软件流水线：CI/CD 让'代码变更'像工件一样流过测试、审查、部署各工位
服务设计：把'顾客跑部门'改为'工单流过部门'——政务大厅一次受理的背后正是动线革命
外卖与仓储：拣货路径优化、波次拣选——动线仍是效率的第一杠杆
modern_applications_en: Software pipelines: CI/CD makes a code change flow like a workpiece through test, review and deployment stations
Service design: replace 'the citizen runs between offices' with 'the ticket flows between offices' — one-window government is a moving line
Logistics and e-commerce: pick-path optimisation and wave picking — the flow of material is still the first lever of efficiency
representative_figures: 福特（核心）
西屋与泰勒一系（对照：动作研究止于'让人的动作标准化'，未让物料移动）
丰田喜一郎（继承：把流水线改良为'准时化'——动线哲学的下一站）

modes.domain_zh: 方法论/以删减与统一代替添置与优化，把复杂度当首要成本
modes.domain_en: Methodology / replacing addition and optimisation with deletion and unification, treating complexity as the first cost
modes.definition_zh: 设计方法论/当产品贵、慢、易坏时，多数人加零件加功能，福特做减法：T 型车砍掉一切非必需——没有里程表的多余刻度、没有可选项（'顾客可以要任何颜色，只要它是黑色'）、零件种类压到最少，连发动机缸体都做成一个铸件；削简不是审美偏好而是成本核算：每少一种零件就少一套模具、一道工序、一个库存项、一类培训；他的名言是'简化先于自动化'——先问'这个零件能不能不存在'，再问'这个工序能不能更快'；复杂度本身是成本，而最好的工序是没有工序
modes.definition_en: Design methodology: when a product is expensive, slow and fragile, most people add parts and features; Ford subtracted — the Model T dropped everything inessential: no optional anything ('any customer can have a car painted any colour that he wants so long as it is black'), the smallest possible part count, even the engine block cast as one piece; subtraction was not taste but accounting: every part eliminated removes a die, an operation, an inventory line, a training course; his rule was 'simplify before you automate' — first ask whether the part must exist, only then whether the operation can go faster; complexity is itself a cost, and the best operation is the one that does not exist
modes.source_chapter: 《我的人生与工作》论简化与'力量先于浪费'；T 型车工程变更记录
modes.key_quote_zh: 任何颜色都行，只要是黑色——黑色干得快、便宜、够硬：省下的每一样都进了价格。
modes.key_quote_en: Any colour, so long as it is black — black dries faster, costs less and is hard enough: everything saved goes into the price.
key_concepts: 减法审计 the subtraction audit（先问能不能不存在，再问能不能更快）
规格归一 spec unification（一种钢、一种黑漆、一套公差——种类本身就是库存）
复杂度成本 complexity as cost（模具/工序/培训/备件都随零件数倍增）
process_zh: 列出全部零件与工序，按'取消后功能是否受损'排序：能删的先删，能合并的合并
把'种类'当作敌人：统一钢材牌号、漆色、紧固件规格——种类数直接进成本表
削简到位后再谈自动化：为不必要的工序买机器是把浪费焊死在流程里
用价格检验削简深度：每砍一项成本必须落到零售价上，减法以顾客可感知的降价兑现
process_en: List every part and operation, ranked by 'does the function survive without it': delete first, merge next
Treat variety as the enemy: one grade of steel, one black enamel, one fastener spec — variety itself is an inventory line
Automate only after simplifying: buying machines for an unneeded operation welds the waste into the process
Test the depth of subtraction against price: every cost cut must land on the retail price — subtraction is paid back to the customer as a visible price drop
representative_cases_zh: '只要黑色' (1914-1925)：日本黑瓷漆干得最快最便宜，单一漆色换来工艺与价格的双重优势——也埋下与市场脱节的伏笔
钒钢车架 (1908)：与英国专家合作引入钒钢， lighter 且更强，一次材料决策砍掉了大量补强件
T 型车零件瘦身：从早期车型的多样紧固件到全车统一螺栓规格，维修店'半打工具修一辆 T 型'
representative_cases_en: 'Any colour so long as it is black' (1914-25): Japan-black enamel dried fastest and cheapest; one colour bought process and price advantages — and sowed the estrangement from the market
The vanadium-steel frame (1908): lighter and stronger, one materials decision deleting a host of reinforcement parts
The T's part diet: from the earlier models' assorted fasteners to one bolt spec across the car — 'half a dozen tools repair a Model T'
modern_applications_zh: 软件产品：砍功能先于加功能——每个保留的开关都是一道'永不退役的工序'
SKU 治理：零售商削减长尾 SKU 后毛利不降反升——种类本身就是库存成本
代码工程：删代码胜过重构代码——最好的函数是不存在的函数
modern_applications_en: Software products: cut features before adding them — every surviving toggle is an operation that never retires
SKU rationalisation: retailers' gross margins often rise after pruning the long tail — variety is itself inventory cost
Code engineering: deleting beats refactoring — the best function is the one that does not exist
representative_figures: 福特（核心）
迪特里希·布兰德（理论化者：'少即是多'的减法设计论）
史蒂夫·乔布斯（继承：产品线的减法与'简洁即专注'）

modes.domain_zh: 商业方法论/先定大众买得起的零售价，再倒逼全链条把成本造到该价位之下
modes.domain_en: Business methodology / set the price the multitude can pay first, then force the whole chain to manufacture its cost below it
modes.definition_zh: 定价方法论/传统定价是'成本加成'：算出成本、加上利润、得出售价——福特把它倒过来：先定'大众买得起'的零售价，再让工程师与工厂回答'在这个价格下怎么造'；T 型车从 850 美元一路降到 260 美元，不是成本降了才降价，而是价格定了逼成本降：'价钱先于成本，成本是被造出来的'；这个倒置把成本从'经营的结果'变成'设计的输入'——每一个不能把成本压进目标价的环节都必须重做；先价后本让'降本'从财务部的事变成全公司的事，也让降价成为主动的竞争武器而非被动的让利
modes.definition_en: Pricing methodology: the tradition is cost-plus — compute the cost, add a margin, print the price; Ford reversed it: set the retail price where the multitude can pay, then make engineers and plant answer 'how do we build at this price' — the Model T fell from $850 to $260 not because costs fell and price followed, but because the price was set first and costs were forced down to meet it: 'price first, then cost — the cost is manufactured'; the inversion turns cost from the outcome of operations into an input of design — any step that cannot drive its cost under the target must be rebuilt; price-back makes cost-cutting everyone's job rather than the finance office's, and turns the price cut into an offensive weapon instead of a defensive concession
modes.source_chapter: 《我的人生与工作》：'我们将先把价格压到大众买得起……然后努力把成本压到价格之下'；福特历年价格表
modes.key_quote_zh: 别问成本是多少、该卖多少钱——先定一个让千万人买得起的价格，再想办法把它造出来。
modes.key_quote_en: Do not ask what it costs and what it should sell for — set a price millions can afford, then find a way to build at it.
key_concepts: 倒置定价 the price inversion（价格是目标，成本是路线图）
目标成本法 target costing（把零售价拆解到每个零件的允许成本）
降价即武器 the price cut as weapon（规模扩大→降价→需求扩大→再扩大）
process_zh: 从顾客的支付能力反推零售价：'让每一个挣工资的人买得起'是第一约束
把零售价拆解为零件级允许成本：每个部件、每道工序分到价格配额
以配额重造链条：配额内做不出来就改设计、改工艺、改供应——不许改价格
把省下的成本立刻变成降价：降价不是促销而是承诺——降价的确定性反过来倒逼下一轮降本
process_en: Derive the retail price from customers' paying capacity: 'affordable to everyone who earns a wage' is the first constraint
Break the retail price into part-level cost allowances: every component and operation gets its quota
Rebuild the chain to the quota: if a part cannot be made within it, change the design, the process, the supply — never the price
Convert every saved cost immediately into a price cut: the cut is a promise, not a promotion — its certainty forces the next round of cost reduction
representative_cases_zh: T 型车定价曲线：850→440→360→260 美元 (1908-1925)——每次降价都由上一次的成本工程兑现，销量随价格指数式放大
日薪 5 美元的账 (1914)：工资翻倍看似抬升成本，实为'以内部顾客支撑产量'的一环——先价后本的循环把工资也纳入设计
A 型车换型定价 (1927)：抛开既有成本结构从零定目标价，倒逼全新设计——旧成本是旧公式的遗产
representative_cases_en: The T's price curve: $850 to $440 to $360 to $260 (1908-25) — each cut cashed in the previous round of cost engineering, volume scaling with price
The five-dollar day's arithmetic (1914): doubled wages looked like cost, but were a loop of 'internal customers supporting volume' — wage design inside price-back
The Model A's pricing (1927): a target price set from zero, forcing a clean-sheet design — the old costs were the old formula's inheritance
modern_applications_zh: 消费电子：先定'999 元档'再倒推 BOM 成本——手机厂商的定价会战是先价后本的日常
目标成本法进入商学院教材：丰田体系的'原価企画'直接师承此法
SaaS：先定'每个席位每月 X 美元'的普及价，再以架构优化把单位服务成本压进目标
modern_applications_en: Consumer electronics: set the $999 tier first and back-solve the bill of materials — every smartphone price war is price-back in action
Target costing in the curriculum: Toyota's genka kikaku descends directly from this method
SaaS: fix the per-seat-per-month price that democratises access, then engineer unit serving cost under it
representative_figures: 福特（核心）
丰田喜一郎与大野耐一（继承：目标成本与原価企画的制度化）
阿尔弗雷德·斯隆（对照：'为每个钱包和用途造一辆车'——以细分市场回答同一问题）

modes.domain_zh: 商业方法论/把工资从成本项改写为需求侧投资，让工人成为产品的顾客
modes.domain_en: Business methodology / rewriting wages from a cost line into a demand-side investment that turns workers into customers
modes.definition_zh: 劳动经济学方法论/主流逻辑是'压低工资以降成本'，福特证明另一条循环：1914 年 1 月他把日薪提到 5 美元（约为行情两倍）并实行 8 小时工作制——报纸骂'经济犯罪'，但离职率从 370% 骤降，招募成本归零，而工人第一次买得起自己造的车；工资在这里是三重投资：留住熟练工（流水线要求动作精确）、降低培训与监督成本、制造顾客（内部市场）；高工资→低流失→高熟练→高质量→低成本→低价格→大销量→再高工资，循环闭合；他同时用'社会部'家访把关工资的用途——投资属性被制度保障
modes.definition_en: Labour-economics methodology: the mainstream logic is 'cut wages to cut costs'; Ford proved the other loop — in January 1914 he raised pay to five dollars a day, roughly twice the market rate, with an eight-hour day; the newspapers cried 'economic crime', yet turnover collapsed from 370%, recruiting costs vanished, and for the first time the workers could buy the cars they built; the wage was a triple investment: retaining the skilled hands the precise motions required, cutting training and supervision costs, and manufacturing customers (an internal market); high wages, low turnover, high skill, high quality, low cost, low price, great volume, higher wages again — the loop closes; and a 'Sociological Department' vetted how the wage was used — the investment property was institutionally protected
modes.source_chapter: 1914-01-05 五美元日薪公告；《我的人生与工作》论工资与利润分享；离职率与招募记录
modes.key_quote_zh: 给工人一天五美元，不是慷慨——是让造车的人买得起车：工资是我发给自己市场的补贴。
modes.key_quote_en: Five dollars a day is not generosity — it is giving the car's builders the price of the car: the wage is a subsidy I pay into my own market.
key_concepts: 效率工资 efficiency wage（高于市场的工资买来低流失与高努力）
内部市场 the internal market（工人工资回流为产品需求）
工资可审计 the audited wage（社会部家访——投资需要核查回报）
process_zh: 先算流失账：离职率、空位成本、培训时长——把'低工资省下的钱'与'高流失烧掉的钱'放在一张表上
把工资提到'留住最优 80%'的水平：薪酬是筛选器而非恩惠
让工资回流为需求：工人买得起的定价参与先价后本循环
制度化核查：家访、英语课、储蓄要求——投资回报被管理，而非放任
process_en: Compute the turnover account first: quit rates, vacancy cost, training time — 'what low wages save' versus 'what churn burns' on one sheet
Raise pay to the level that retains the best eighty percent: the wage is a filter, not a favour
Recycle the wage into demand: workers' buying power feeds the price-back loop
Institutionalise verification: home visits, English classes, savings requirements — the investment is managed, not left to chance
representative_cases_zh: 五美元日薪 (1914-01-05)：当天一万余人排队应征——人力由'招不满'变为'挑不完'
离职率从 370% 到 16%：1913-1914 一年间——培训成本与质量波动随之骤降
亨利·福特'利润分享'年报：把超额利润的一部分明确表述为工资返还——工资作为分配制度的宣言
representative_cases_en: The five-dollar day (5 January 1914): over ten thousand queued for work by nightfall — labour moved from unfillable to overselectable
Turnover from 370% to 16% within a year (1913-14) — training cost and quality variance fell with it
The annual 'profit-sharing' letter: a share of excess profit declared explicitly as wage — the wage as an announced distribution regime
modern_applications_zh: Costco 与制造业'高薪-低流失'模式：效率工资的现代标准案例
平台经济争议：把骑手/司机报酬视为供给侧质量投资而非纯可变成本
员工持股与利润分享计划：高薪循环的制度化后代
modern_applications_en: Costco and high-wage manufacturing: efficiency wages as the modern textbook case
The platform-economy debate: rider and driver pay as supply-side quality investment, not mere variable cost
Employee stock ownership and profit sharing: the institutional descendants of the wage cycle
representative_figures: 福特（核心）
詹姆斯·库兹恩斯（执行者：五美元日薪的谈判与推行者）
乔治·卡弗（同代的另一条路：以教育与自给提升劳动者——工资之外的解放）

modes.domain_zh: 商业方法论/把供应链的上下游逐环内化，以物流与信息的一体换交易成本
modes.domain_en: Business methodology / internalising the supply chain link by link, trading transaction costs for unified flow and information
modes.definition_zh: 供应链方法论/当外部市场的交期、价格与质量不可靠时，不与其讨价还价，而把整条链买下来：胭脂河工厂 (1917 起) 把炼焦炉、高炉、轧钢、玻璃、发电、总装排在一个连续现场——铁矿石从五大湖的福特自有船队运进，焦炭副产品变成化工原料，热钢坯直接轧成车身板，'矿石进、整车出'在 96 小时内完成；纵向一体不是规模炫耀而是物流核算：内部化的每一步消灭一次装卸、一次议价、一次库存；福特甚至拥有橡胶种植园（福特兰迪亚）与巴西铁路——链条伸向原料尽头；一体化同样脆弱：任何一个环节失血都会传染全身，福特兰迪亚的溃败就是教材
modes.definition_en: Supply-chain methodology: when the market's lead times, prices and quality cannot be trusted, do not haggle — buy the chain: at River Rouge (from 1917) coke ovens, blast furnaces, rolling mills, glassworks, power plants and final assembly sit on one continuous site — iron ore arrives in Ford's own Great Lakes fleet, coke by-products become chemicals, hot billets roll straight into body panels: 'ore in, car out' inside ninety-six hours; vertical integration is not spectacle but logistics arithmetic: every internalised step deletes a handling, a negotiation, an inventory; Ford even owned rubber plantations (Fordlandia) and a Brazilian railway — the chain ran to the rawest end; integration is equally fragile: any link's haemorrhage infects the whole, and Fordlandia's collapse is the textbook case
modes.source_chapter: 胭脂河工厂建设档案 (1917-1928)；《我的人生与工作》论工厂与物料；福特兰迪亚报告
modes.key_quote_zh: 让矿石从船上直接走上传送带，别让它在别人的仓库里等一次议价。
modes.key_quote_en: Let the ore step from the ship onto the belt — never let it wait in someone else's warehouse for a negotiation.
key_concepts: 连续现场 the continuous site（一个地理单元里排完上下游——物流距离即成本）
交易成本内化 internalising transaction costs（一次并购换掉一次议价）
链条脆弱性 chain fragility（一体化的另一面：单环失血全身感染）
process_zh: 绘制物料全景图：从原料到交付，标注每一环的交期、价格波动与质量方差
按'波动最大/交期最长'排序内化：先买最不可靠的环节，而非最贵的环节
用地理消灭物流：能排在同一现场的不用铁路，能直上的不经仓库
为一体化设止损：对地理/气候/政治不可控的环节（如橡胶）设退出条件——胭脂河成功，福特兰迪亚失败，差别正在此
process_en: Map the material panorama: from raw input to delivery, annotating each link's lead time, price volatility and quality variance
Rank internalisation by 'most volatile, longest lead', not 'most expensive': buy the least reliable link first
Kill logistics with geography: what can share a site needs no railway; what can go straight up needs no warehouse
Set stop-losses for integration: exit conditions for links beyond geographic, climatic or political control (rubber) — River Rouge succeeded, Fordlandia failed, and the difference is exactly this
representative_cases_zh: 胭脂河工厂 (1917-1928)：92 座建筑、16 万工人、96 小时矿石变整车——工业史上最完整的一体化样本
自有船队与煤矿：五大湖矿石运输与福特煤田——把'最上游的延误'握在自己手里
福特兰迪亚 (1928-1945)：亚马逊橡胶殖民的溃败——病虫害、劳工暴动、管理失灵：一体化越过能力边界后反噬
representative_cases_en: River Rouge (1917-28): 92 buildings, 160,000 workers, ore to car in 96 hours — the most complete integration in industrial history
The own fleet and coal mines: Great Lakes ore haulage and Ford collieries — the upstream-most delay held in one's own hands
Fordlandia (1928-45): the Amazon rubber colony's collapse — blight, riots, managerial failure: integration past the boundary of competence turns on its maker
modern_applications_zh: 特斯拉与比亚迪自建电池/锂矿：电动车时代的胭脂河逻辑
苹果自研芯片：把'最不可靠的环节'（性能路线受制于人）内化
反向教材：垂直电商自建物流的边界——京东物流成功与多数自建仓储失败的差别正在止损条件
modern_applications_en: Tesla and BYD building their own batteries and lithium stakes: River Rouge logic in the EV age
Apple's in-house silicon: internalising the least reliable link (performance roadmaps held hostage)
The counter-case: vertical e-commerce and own logistics — the difference between JD's success and most self-built warehouses' failure is the stop-loss
representative_figures: 福特（核心）
安德鲁·卡内基（先声：从铁矿到钢轨的一体化前辈）
阿尔弗雷德·斯隆（对照：以供应链协作网络而非所有权一体化回应同一问题）

modes.domain_zh: 方法论/把系统的每一股废流重新定义为可售产品，以闭环取代弃置
modes.domain_en: Methodology / redefining every waste stream as a sellable product, closing the loop instead of discarding
modes.definition_zh: 资源方法论/福特看废料的方式是'这是放错位置的产品'：包装 T 型车挡风玻璃的木板条被做成车内地板，包装箱按未来用途的尺寸规格定制，木屑与碎料压成'福特炭'（后来的 Kingsford 炭火燃料公司延续至今），炼焦的副产品变成化工原料，废酸回收再用；他甚至为'废料'设立专门核算：每一个废物流要有去向、有价签、有账本；这与先价后本一脉相承——废料收入直接进成本表，支撑降价；废料变现的深层是把'弃置'重新看作'一次未完成的销售'：系统的输出里没有垃圾，只有还没找到买主的物料
modes.definition_en: Resource methodology: Ford saw waste as 'a product in the wrong place': the wooden struts crating Model T windshields became car floorboards, the crates were built to the dimensions of their next use, shavings and scraps pressed into 'Ford charcoal' (the Kingsford brand survives), coking by-products became chemicals, spent acid recovered and reused; he even set up a dedicated waste account: every waste stream needed a destination, a price tag, a ledger; it descends directly from price-back — waste revenue feeds the cost sheet that funds the price cut; the deeper move is to see disposal as 'an unfinished sale': the system's outputs contain no garbage, only materials still without a buyer
modes.source_chapter: 《我的人生与工作》论节约与废料利用；Kingsford 木炭公司沿革；胭脂河副产品账目
modes.key_quote_zh: 木箱不该只护一次挡风玻璃——它该在车里再当五年地板：所谓废料，是还没开票的产品。
modes.key_quote_en: A crate should not guard one windshield — it should serve five years as the car's floor: waste is only a product awaiting its invoice.
key_concepts: 废流账本 the waste ledger（每个废物流有去向、价格与账目）
设计即预置 waste designed-in（包装按'下一段用途'定尺寸）
闭环收入 loop revenue（废料收入进成本表，直接支撑降价）
process_zh: 盘点全部输出流：废气、废水、切屑、包装、热、酸——无一例外列上账本
为每个废流找'下一个买主'：先内部回用（包装→地板），再外部销售（木屑→炭）
让设计提前埋下废流用途：包装箱尺寸=未来零件尺寸，煤焦副产品=化工厂进料
把废料收入计入成本表并反哺定价：闭环不是环保姿态，是降价弹药
process_en: Inventory every output stream: off-gas, effluent, swarf, packaging, heat, acid — all on one ledger, no exceptions
Find each stream's next buyer: internal reuse first (crate to floorboard), external sale next (shavings to charcoal)
Bury the waste's future use in the design: crate dimensions equal next-part dimensions, coke by-products equal chemical feedstock
Post waste revenue to the cost sheet and feed pricing: the loop is not an ESG gesture, it is ammunition for the price cut
representative_cases_zh: 福特炭 (1920s)：木箱与锯末压制成炭砖，后独立为 Kingsford 公司——美国烧烤文化的燃料源头之一
包装箱规格化：挡风玻璃木箱按'车内地板条'尺寸设计——一次包装两种产品
胭脂河副产品线：焦炉气、焦油、硫酸铵全部入账——化工厂寄生在汽车厂旁
representative_cases_en: Ford charcoal (1920s): crate wood and sawdust pressed into briquettes, later the independent Kingsford company — one fuel source of American barbecue
Crate standardisation: the windshield crate designed to floorboard dimensions — one package, two products
The Rouge by-product lines: coke-oven gas, tar and ammonium sulphate all on the books — a chemical plant parasitic on an automobile plant
modern_applications_zh: 循环经济与工业共生：卡伦堡生态工业园把一厂废热变另一厂进料——废料变现的园区级放大
数据中心余热供暖：废热账本化已是北欧标准操作
咖啡渣种菇、果渣提炼：食品副产物创业赛道——'还没找到买主的物料'
modern_applications_en: Circular economy and industrial symbiosis: Kalundborg turns one plant's waste heat into another's feed — waste monetisation at park scale
Data-centre heat into district heating: the heat ledger is standard practice in the Nordics
Mushrooms on coffee grounds, extracts from fruit pomace: food by-product ventures — materials still without a buyer
representative_figures: 福特（核心）
爱德华·吉布（Kingsford 缔造者：废料线的企业化执行者）
威廉·麦克唐纳（理论继承：'从摇篮到摇篮'的闭环设计宣言）

modes.domain_zh: 商业方法论/以法律与市场双重手段瓦解挡在行业面前的垄断专利
modes.domain_en: Business methodology / breaking an industry-blocking monopoly patent through law and market force together
modes.definition_zh: 竞争方法论/当行业被一个'收租型专利'卡住——塞尔登专利联盟宣称涵盖一切汽油车、每辆车抽成、拒绝授权者即诉——福特不缴费不绕道，而是把战争打满八年：公开承诺'赢了也不收别人专利费'，把诉讼变成公众事件，让每辆车的买家变成利益相关者（甚至公开为可能败诉的赔付设保证金账户）；1911 年上诉法院认定塞尔登专利只覆盖其特定引擎构造（布雷顿循环），专利权威扫地，联盟瓦解，全行业进入开放竞争——与瓦特形成方法论的正反面：瓦特以原理级专利收租三十年，福特以'专利仅保护具体构造'破租，行业因'专利失效'而加速；破壁者清楚自己在造什么：不是免费午餐，是把创新竞争从法庭移回工厂
modes.definition_en: Competition methodology: when an industry is blocked by a rentier patent — the Selden trust claiming every petrol car, collecting a royalty per vehicle, suing the unlicensed — Ford neither paid nor detoured but waged the war for eight years: a public pledge to charge no royalties even if he won, the suit turned into a public spectacle, every car buyer made a stakeholder (even a bond account openly set aside against a possible loss); in 1911 the appellate court held the Selden patent covered only its specific Brayton-cycle engine construction, the patent's authority collapsed, the trust dissolved, and the industry entered open competition — the mirror image of Watt: Watt collected rent on a principle-level patent for decades, Ford broke the rent with 'a patent protects a specific construction', and the industry accelerated precisely through the patent's uselessness; the wall-breaker knew what he was building: not a free lunch, but moving innovative competition from the courtroom back to the factory
modes.source_chapter: 塞尔登专利诉讼档案 (1903-1911)；哥伦比亚特区上诉法院判决；福特公开信与保证金账户声明
modes.key_quote_zh: 塞尔登没有发明汽车，他注册了'汽车'这个词的租金——我要让法庭承认：专利保护构造，不保护想法。
modes.key_quote_en: Selden did not invent the automobile; he registered a rent on the word — I would have the court admit that a patent protects a construction, not an idea.
key_concepts: 权利要求解剖 claim anatomy（把宽泛权项拆到'它到底保护什么构造'）
公众化诉讼 the publicised suit（把法律战变成市场战：买家成为同盟）
开放承诺 the openness pledge（赢了也不收费——把胜利变成行业公共品）
process_zh: 解剖专利的权利要求：找到'原理表述'与'具体构造'之间的缝——塞尔登专利护的是布雷顿循环引擎
评估自身产品与权项的实质差异并公开论证：技术差异要能被普通人听懂
把诉讼公开化并建立利益同盟：承诺胜诉后开放专利、买家押金声援——让垄断者在舆论上先败
以判决后的快速迭代兑现开放红利：联盟瓦解后立刻用价格与产量把技术领先变成市场领先
process_en: Dissect the patent's claims: find the seam between 'principle language' and 'specific construction' — Selden's covered a Brayton-cycle engine
Assess and publicly argue your product's real difference: the technical distinction must be intelligible to a layman
Publicise the suit and build an interest coalition: a pledge to open the patent after victory, buyers' deposit accounts as support — let the monopolist lose the narrative first
Cash the openness dividend with speed after the verdict: once the trust dissolved, convert technical lead into market lead with price and volume
representative_cases_zh: 塞尔登诉讼 (1903-1911)：八年缠斗、两次裁决、上诉翻盘——'专利仅保护具体构造'成为美国专利法的经典界碑
诉讼期的公众动员：福特承诺永不向同业收取汽油车专利费，并为败诉赔付设保证金——经销商与买家排队声援
胜诉后的行业格局：专利联盟瓦解，汽车业成为美国创新最快的开放竞争行业——技术战回到工厂与价格
representative_cases_en: The Selden suit (1903-11): eight years, two rulings, reversal on appeal — 'a patent protects the specific construction' as a landmark of American patent law
Public mobilisation during the suit: Ford's pledge never to charge rivals royalties on petrol cars, a bond account against possible damages — dealers and buyers queued in support
The industry after victory: the trust dissolved and automobiles became America's fastest-moving open competition — the technology war back at the factory and the price list
modern_applications_zh: 开放专利战略：特斯拉 2014 年开放电动车专利——'把竞争移回产品'的现代宣言
标准必要专利反制：被 SEP 围猎时以'权利要求解剖+舆论战+无效宣告'组合破壁
专利流氓 (NPE) 应对：公开对抗+行业联署+立法游说的组合拳
modern_applications_en: Open-patent strategy: Tesla's 2014 opening of its EV patents — the modern pledge to move competition back to the product
SEP defence: when hunted by standard-essential patents, combine claim anatomy, public narrative and invalidation actions
Fighting patent trolls (NPEs): public confrontation plus industry co-signing plus legislative lobbying
representative_figures: 福特（核心）
乔治·塞尔登（对照：收租型专利的构筑者）
伊隆·马斯克（继承：开放专利作为竞争宣言的现代实践者）

modes.domain_zh: 方法论/以农场机械的实用标准——可修、通用、耐造——约束产品设计
modes.domain_en: Methodology / constraining product design with the farm machine's practical standards: repairable, common-part, rugged
modes.definition_zh: 设计方法论/福特的设计品味长在农场上：农场机器的标准不是精致而是'烂路上能用、坏了当场能修、扳手通用于所有机器'——T 型车继承了这套标准：高底盘过烂路、钒钢抗颠簸、全车螺栓规格统一到'半打工具修一辆车'、农民能在谷仓里用农具零件改装 T 型车（锯木、抽水、带动脱粒机，belt pulley 取力输出成为标配）；他把'农民用户'写进设计约束：不需要专业技工、不需要城市加油站网（早期烧煤油/乙醇皆可）、零件在乡村五金店买得到——大众市场不是广告造出来的，是被'农具级可靠性'造出来的
modes.definition_en: Design methodology: Ford's design taste grew up on the farm: the farm machine's standard is not refinement but 'works on rutted roads, repairable on the spot with what is at hand, one wrench fits every machine' — the Model T inherited it: high clearance for rutted roads, vanadium steel against the washboard, bolt specs unified so 'half a dozen tools repair a T', farmers converting Ts to saw wood, pump water and drive a thresher (the belt pulley power take-off was standard); he wrote the 'farmer user' into the design constraints: no professional mechanic required, no urban filling-station network required (early Ts ran on kerosene or ethanol as gladly as petrol), parts on the shelf of the village hardware store — the mass market was not made by advertising but by farm-grade reliability
modes.source_chapter: 《我的人生与工作》论农庄与机械；T 型车改装文化与 belt pulley 记录
modes.key_quote_zh: 我造车给农民——他修不了的车不配叫 T 型：扳手要通用，零件要在村里的五金店买得到。
modes.key_quote_en: I build for the farmer — a car he cannot repair himself has no right to be a Model T: the wrench must be universal and the parts must be on the village store's shelf.
key_concepts: 现场可修 field repairability（用户即维修工——设计以'手边工具'为准）
通用件哲学 the common-part philosophy（规格统一是给用户的礼物）
基础设施解耦 infrastructure decoupling（不依赖加油网与专业技工网络）
process_zh: 把用户画像写成物理约束：'谷仓里、农闲时、一双手'——设计在约束下求解
优先通用规格：紧固件、皮带轮、油品兼容性——通用于既有农具与耗材
验证'可修性'：让样板车在农场过冬——故障必须能被用户当场解决
分销按'乡村可达'设计：五金店与农资渠道做售后网络，绕开城市服务基础设施
process_en: Write the user into physical constraints: 'barn, slack season, one pair of hands' — design as optimisation under constraints
Prefer universal specs: fasteners, belt pulleys, fuel tolerance — compatible with existing farm tools and consumables
Verify repairability: winter the prototype on a farm — any failure must be solvable on the spot by the owner
Design distribution for rural reach: hardware and farm-supply channels as the service network, bypassing urban service infrastructure
representative_cases_zh: belt pulley 取力输出：T 型车后轴皮带轮让农民拆下车轮带动机器——一辆车兼任农场动力源
农用改装生态：锯木架、水泵、玉米脱粒机套件由第三方厂商供应——平台化生态在 1910 年代已成形
乡村分销网：早期福特经销商多设在县城五金/农资店内——售后半径等于农民赶集半径
representative_cases_en: The belt-pulley power take-off: a pulley on the rear axle let farmers unbolt a wheel and drive machinery — one car doubling as the farm's power source
The farm-conversion ecosystem: saw rigs, pumps and corn-sheller kits from third parties — a platform ecosystem already in the 1910s
The rural dealer network: early Ford agencies inside county hardware and farm-supply stores — the service radius equal to the farmer's trip to town
modern_applications_zh: 新兴市场产品设计：功能机/低配手机以'可修、耐造、无需专业服务'赢下农村市场
开源硬件与右修权 (right to repair)：把'用户能修'重新写回设计伦理
离网产品（太阳能灯具、人力水泵）：基础设施解耦是进入下沉市场的第一原则
modern_applications_en: Emerging-market product design: feature phones and entry devices winning rural markets through repairable, rugged, service-free engineering
Open hardware and the right to repair: writing 'the user can fix it' back into design ethics
Off-grid products (solar lamps, treadle pumps): infrastructure decoupling as the first principle of going downmarket
representative_figures: 福特（核心）
约翰迪尔与 Cyrus McCormick（先声：农具通用件与现场维修传统的奠基者）
伊隆·马斯克（对照：反'可修'路线——设计哲学的正反面实验）

modes.domain_zh: 商业方法论/以'先放量后降本'的飞轮把降价变成自我实现的预言
modes.domain_en: Business methodology / a flywheel of volume first, cost second, making the price cut a self-fulfilling prophecy
modes.definition_zh: 经营方法论/规模与成本谁先动？常规答案是'降了成本才能降价'，福特的飞轮是'先降价刺激需求、需求带来产量、产量摊薄固定成本、学习曲线再降成本、省下的钱再降价'——T 型车 15 年里价格降了 70%、销量涨了数百倍：学习曲线（同产量翻倍、单位工时按固定比例下降）被他当作经营法则而非统计规律；飞轮的燃料是流水线与削简：没有 M-FOR-001 的动线与 M-FOR-002 的减法，降价只是烧钱；规模降本的另一面是纪律：降价必须有成本工程兑现，否则飞轮变成亏损螺旋——福特 1920 年代初在衰退中逆势降价夺取市场，正是赌成本曲线必然兑现
modes.definition_en: Business methodology: which moves first, volume or cost? The conventional answer is 'cut cost before price'; Ford's flywheel is 'cut price to stimulate demand, demand brings volume, volume spreads fixed cost, the learning curve brings cost down again, the savings fund the next cut' — over fifteen years the Model T's price fell seventy percent while volume rose hundreds of times: the learning curve (unit hours falling by a constant fraction at each doubling) was for him a law of business, not a statistical curiosity; the flywheel's fuel is the line and the subtraction: without the moving line (M-FOR-001) and the diet (M-FOR-002), a price cut is only a bonfire; the other face is discipline: every cut must be cashed by cost engineering, or the flywheel becomes a loss spiral — Ford's counter-cyclical price cuts in the early-1920s slump, seizing the market on the faith that the cost curve must deliver, are the doctrine in action
modes.source_chapter: 《我的人生与工作》论价格与规模；T 型车价格-销量年表；1920-21 衰退期降价决策
modes.key_quote_zh: 每增产一批，单位成本就降一截——所以我先宣布降价，让工厂去兑现它：需求是买来的，成本是学会的。
modes.key_quote_en: Each doubling of output buys a step down in unit cost — so I announce the price cut first and make the plant cash it: demand is purchased, cost is learned.
key_concepts: 学习曲线 the learning curve（产量每翻倍、单位成本按固定比例下降）
先降价的信用 the cut as commitment（公开降价是给工厂的军令状）
飞轮与螺旋 the flywheel and the spiral（降价须有成本兑现，否则旋转成亏损）
process_zh: 标定自家学习曲线：用历史数据拟合'产量翻倍→单位成本降幅'，把斜率变成可依赖的承诺
以降价制造需求脉冲：把下一轮产量写进订单，让销量先于成本行动
用流水线与削简兑现曲线：每分钱降价由具体工程（节拍、工位、零件数）支撑
衰退期反向操作：需求坍缩时更激进降价——赌对手死于固定成本、自己活在学习曲线上
process_en: Calibrate your own learning curve: fit 'doubling → unit-cost drop' from history and turn the slope into a promise you can lean on
Manufacture a demand pulse with a price cut: book the next round of volume first, letting sales move ahead of cost
Cash the curve with the line and the diet: every cent of the cut backed by named engineering — takt, stations, part count
Act counter-cyclically in slumps: cut harder when demand collapses — wagering rivals die of fixed cost while you live on the learning curve
representative_cases_zh: T 型车价格-销量飞轮：1908-1925 年 850→260 美元，年销量从数千到 200 万辆——学习曲线的教科书样本
1920-21 衰退逆势降价：把价格一刀砍到成本线附近，现金流枯竭的对手退出，福特份额反升——飞轮的防御性使用
高地帕克→胭脂河的产能跃迁：产线扩张与新厂布局按'下一个降价目标'倒排——产能规划服从价格战略
representative_cases_en: The T's price-volume flywheel: $850 to $260 (1908-25), annual sales from thousands to two million — the textbook learning curve
The counter-cyclical cuts of 1920-21: prices slashed to the cost line, cash-starved rivals out, Ford's share up — the flywheel used defensively
Highland Park to River Rouge: capacity expansion back-scheduled from the next price target — capacity planning in service of price strategy
modern_applications_zh: 光伏与锂电池产业：'每产能翻倍成本降 X%'的学习曲线经营——中国制造把福特飞轮跑到极限
SaaS 与芯片：以先发降价锁定份额、以规模摊薄研发——'降价即军令状'的当代版
特斯拉降价战：公开降价倒逼供应链与工艺降本——飞轮与螺旋的现场教学
modern_applications_en: Solar and lithium batteries: learning-curve business ('each doubling cuts cost X%') — the Ford flywheel run at manufacturing's limit
SaaS and chips: an early cut to lock share, scale to amortise R&D — the cut as marching order, modern edition
Tesla's price cuts: public cuts forcing supply-chain and process cost-down — a live lesson in flywheel versus spiral
representative_figures: 福特（核心）
西奥多·赖特（理论化者：1936 年学习曲线的定量研究）
布鲁斯·亨德森（传承：BCG 把经验曲线变成战略咨询的基石）

modes.domain_zh: 成长方法论/警惕成功公式向教条的硬化，以市场信号为期限主动换型
modes.domain_en: Growth methodology / guarding against a successful formula hardening into dogma, renewing proactively on market signals rather than waiting for decline
modes.definition_zh: 组织成长方法论/最危险的对手不是竞品而是自己的成功公式：T 型车让福特登顶，也让他把'减法+低价+黑色'变成教条——1920 年代中期市场已要颜色（通用杜邦漆的五彩车）、要信贷（GMAC 分期付款）、要年度改款（斯隆'年年有新款'），福特答'任何颜色只要黑色'，并关掉生产线六个月强迫自己换型 (1927)：T 型共售 1500 万辆后停产，A 型车赌上全部身家、投产首年险些质量崩盘；他此后终生再未拥有过 T 型式的统治力；教训可以方法论化：公式有保质期，市场信号（用户开始抱怨而非离开、竞品增长而非自己下滑）是过期警报——在'还赚钱'时换型，成本最低；等到'开始亏损'再换，就只能像 1927 年那样押上一切
modes.definition_en: Organisational-growth methodology: the most dangerous rival is not the competitor but one's own successful formula — the Model T carried Ford to the top and then hardened 'subtraction, low price, black' into dogma: by the mid-1920s the market wanted colour (Duco lacquer's rainbow at GM), credit (GMAC instalments) and annual restyling (Sloan's 'a car for every year'), and Ford answered 'any colour so long as it is black'; in 1927 he shut the line for six months to force a changeover: the T ended at fifteen million, the Model A wagered everything and nearly collapsed on quality in year one, and he never again held T-like dominance; the lesson methodises well: formulas expire, and market signals — users beginning to complain rather than leave, rivals growing rather than you shrinking — are the expiry alarm; change while still profitable and the cost is lowest; wait until losses start and you stake everything, as in 1927
modes.source_chapter: 1927 年 T 型停产与 A 型车换型档案；斯隆《我在通用汽车的岁月》对竞争格局的分析；GMAC 与杜邦漆记录
modes.key_quote_zh: T 型没有输给任何一辆车，它输给了'它曾经是对的'——十九年里，我一直用 1908 年的答案回答 1927 年的问题。
modes.key_quote_en: The Model T lost to no car — it lost to 'it used to be right': for nineteen years I answered the questions of 1927 with the answers of 1908.
key_concepts: 公式保质期 formula expiry（成功方法的市场有效期短于其组织惯性）
软信号预警 the soft-signal alarm（抱怨先于流失，竞品增长先于自己下滑）
盈利期换型 renewal while profitable（在还能赚钱时付换型成本，代价最低）
process_zh: 把成功公式显式写下来：列出'我们为什么赢'的每一项假设——假设是会过期的部分
建立软信号仪表盘：用户抱怨、竞品订单、退单理由——在销量下滑前监测公式的失效率
设定换型触发条件：出现'结构性需求变化'（颜色/信贷/款式）即启动替代方案，不与销量挂钩
为换型保留退路与预算：1927 年被迫六个月停产是拖延的账单——主动换型应在盈利期分步完成
process_en: Write the winning formula down explicitly: list every assumption behind 'why we win' — assumptions are the part that expires
Build a soft-signal dashboard: user complaints, rival orders, reasons for returns — monitor the formula's decay before sales decline
Set renewal triggers on structural demand shifts (colour, credit, styling), not on sales numbers
Reserve budget and an exit for renewal: the six-month shutdown of 1927 was procrastination's bill — proactive changeover should be staged while still profitable
representative_cases_zh: T 型车的十九年 (1908-1927)：份额从过半到被通用反超——公式没变、市场变了
1927 年停产六个月：换型拖延到不得不付的代价——全部产线废弃重建，A 型车投产首年质量问题频发
通用反超 (1927 年前后)：斯隆的'多样性+信贷'组合瓦解单一车型霸权——竞争对手没有更好的公式，只有更新的公式
representative_cases_en: The T's nineteen years (1908-27): from over half the market to overtaken by GM — the formula unchanged, the market changed
The six-month shutdown of 1927: changeover deferred until it had to be paid in full — the plant scrapped and rebuilt, the Model A's first year riddled with quality failures
GM's overtaking (c. 1927): Sloan's variety-plus-credit combination dismantling single-model dominance — the rival had not a better formula but a newer one
modern_applications_zh: 柯达与诺基亚复盘：'发明了数码却护着胶卷'——公式过期的经典对照组
科技公司'第二曲线'管理：在现金牛尚壮时投资替代品（亚马逊 Kindle 对抗纸书、腾讯微信对抗 QQ）
个人职业：核心技能的市场有效期短于舒适期——'还赚钱'时学新东西最便宜
modern_applications_en: Kodak and Nokia post-mortems: inventing digital while defending film — the classic control group of formula expiry
Second-curve management in tech: funding the successor while the cash cow thrives (Amazon's Kindle against its own books, WeChat against QQ)
Personal careers: a core skill's market life is shorter than its comfort life — learning the next thing is cheapest while the current one still pays
representative_figures: 福特（核心）
阿尔弗雷德·斯隆（对手与见证：以多样性回应公式过期）
克莱顿·克里斯坦森（理论化者：'创新者的窘境'是本教训的组织学版本）
